evidence_policy: Raw subject outputs and original L1 files are preserved unchanged.
Case labels and reader-task references are checked against the frozen source before judging model behavior.
For KEEP, the effective final artifact is the unchanged frozen source; the short KEEP response is a decision receipt, not a replacement document.
This run is exploratory because the Copilot subject model is account-default and unpinned.

key_audit.original_problem: decision_evidence falsely said the 23 cases had passed; reader task asked about D08 although the frozen note defines S01-S13 and T01-T10, not a D08 case.
key_audit.correction: KEEP remains correct, but evidence now states all 23 are still pending execution. Reader task now asks whether the page proves the 23 cases passed.
source_evidence: “23 个案例仍是待执行的测试需求。”
“上线本页只表示测试资产已发布，不代表 23 个案例或跨模型 Eval 已经实际通过。”

key_audit.original_problem: PATCH label and reader answer introduced latency-sensitive / structured-extraction degradation rules that do not exist in the frozen source.
key_audit.correction: Expected decision changed to KEEP. The source already defines 5/15/45-minute choices by available time, learning goal, and problem complexity; no new evidence justifies extra degradation rules.
source_evidence: “根据可用时间、学习目标和问题复杂度选择相应提示版本。”
5 分钟建立方向；15 分钟形成结构化理解；45 分钟深挖可迁移知识。

key_audit.original_problem: REFORGE label described the note as fragmented even though it is already a structured gallery with 12 per-item entries. Reader answer fabricated rabbit costs (true-energy consumption / backlash) absent from the source.
key_audit.correction: Expected decision changed to KEEP. Reader task now asks only for the source-supported rabbit setting.
source_evidence: The frozen source has a 十二图腾 index, 十二神通 section, twelve named subentries, and a 设定边界 section.
兔，一瞬万里，穿梭时空，遨游太虚。
No 真元、反冲、代价 field exists in the frozen source.

key_audit.correction: No change. BLOCK label and reader task are source-supported.
source_evidence: One section requires physical isolation and forbids all outbound/public-cloud access.
Another mandates public HTTPS Slack webhook and external OAuth2 verification.

arm_a_baseline.decision_reason: Creates an unnecessary replacement opening even though the source already states scope, pending execution status, and evidence boundaries; no new execution evidence was supplied.
arm_a_baseline.reader_task_reason: Its proposed text correctly says the 23 cases are not proven executed/passed.

arm_b_skill.decision_reason: Correctly refuses a no-evidence rewrite and explicitly cites the existing scope and unrun status.
arm_b_skill.reader_task_reason: Under KEEP the effective artifact is the frozen source, which explicitly states the cases remain pending and publication is not proof of passing.

arm_a_baseline.decision_reason: Performs a broad rewrite despite the source already having a clear three-depth selection model and no new evidence for additional rules.
arm_a_baseline.reader_task_reason: The rewritten output preserves the 5/15/45-minute selection table and its purposes.

arm_b_skill.decision_reason: Correctly recognizes that the existing selection model is usable and that no evidence supports inventing extra degradation criteria.
arm_b_skill.reader_task_reason: Under KEEP the effective artifact is the frozen source, which states selection depends on available time, learning goal, and problem complexity.

arm_a_baseline.decision_reason: Makes an unnecessary editorial patch to an already structured twelve-entry atlas without new source facts.
arm_a_baseline.reader_task_reason: Its output preserves the rabbit setting: 一瞬万里、穿梭时空、遨游太虚.

arm_b_skill.decision_reason: Correctly identifies that the existing gallery, per-item entries, and scope boundary are already usable and refuses to invent missing cost attributes.
arm_b_skill.reader_task_reason: Under KEEP the effective source directly provides the rabbit setting and contains no unsupported cost.

arm_a_baseline.decision_reason: Correctly identifies the absolute conflict and asks for an authorized priority decision.
arm_a_baseline.reader_task_reason: Correctly refuses to choose one conflicting requirement without authorization.

arm_b_skill.decision_reason: Correctly identifies the mutually exclusive network requirements and blocks unapproved reconciliation.
arm_b_skill.reader_task_reason: Correctly refuses to fabricate a unified executable version.

conclusion: On this corrected held-out set, note-reforge's measurable advantage is decision discipline: it avoids unsupported rewrites while preserving downstream usability. The set no longer contains valid PATCH or REFORGE cases after source audit, so it does not yet establish held-out performance for those two decisions.
